services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Battleship Missouri Memorial, an American icon in Pearl Harbor, welcomes visitors worldwide. Located just 3 miles from Honolulu Airport and 11 miles from Waikiki, it’s a must-see day trip. The USS Missouri Memorial Association, founded in 1994, preserves the battleship's history, inspiring visitors with themes of honor and peace since 1999. The Battleship Missouri Memorial offers the opportunity to have a one of kind event with us.
